name: HODL
fix_description: Same as MCC (bench-217). In deliver, reducing _rTotal manipulates the reflect rate, creating balance/reserve mismatch in LP pair. Fix: exclude LP pair from rate changes or add same-block protection.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC involves a highly protocol-specific attack against a reflection token integrated with a Uniswap V2 pair, requiring deep understanding of reflected supply accounting, pair reserve/balance desynchronization, flash loans, callback-driven swaps, skim abuse, and repeated state manipulations. The exploit chain is long and non-obvious, with many carefully tuned iterative steps and parameters, so reproducing and understanding it would likely take an experienced auditor well over 2 hours.
